The modifications in both files are closely related as they work together to ensure that memory barriers are correctly applied to I/O operations on the Alpha architecture. The changes in `io.h` define the interface and behavior of the I/O functions, while the changes in `io.c` provide the actual implementations. By adding memory barriers before read operations in both files, the patch addresses the issue of potential reordering of I/O accesses that could lead to system hangs, particularly on the Alpha Avanti platform. This ensures that the behavior of the I/O functions conforms to the specifications and prevents issues caused by missing barriers between writes and reads.
